content.short: Cardano wallet including Layer 2 and NFT minting.
content.description:
As part of the Camelcoin Project, The Hump Wallet is a new wallet for the cardano ecosytem.

As secured as daedalus and faster than Yoroi, it allow to send, receive and store Cardano assets and NFTs as well as Avalanche tokens and NFTs in the same wallet without to have to switch network all the time.

The user interface is just awesomely easy. and intuitive. You can also Mint NFTs by Uploading or straight through your phone's camera.
